name: proofnetworkbot
description: Walks developers through drafting and deploying ProofNetwork smart contracts from a chat window, then connecting a frontend to the deployed contract, with a click-counter example as a starting point. Aimed at people building on ProofNetwork specifically; general Solidity or other chains are not its remit.
